description: Cross-repo registration record for pre-registered values (audit-2026-07 finding 9). scripts/config.test.mjs asserts scripts/config.mjs against this file; the app repo mirrors these values in its registered constants (Metrics.kt, Watch.kt, Verdicts.kt, Calibration.kt). Changing a value here is a public re-registration.
reregistered_2026_07_26: The rolling trailingWindow (120 readings) is RETIRED and replaced by a fixed pre-treatment baseline (baselineStart..baselineEnd, never rolling), and the exclusion window is WIDENED from 2020-01..2021-12 to unusableStart..unusableEnd so the 2021-22 exposed-industry hiring overshoot cannot help define normal. Both changes make previously-published z-scores non-comparable to ones computed after this date: the old readings were scored against a baseline that was mostly post-2020, so they read closer to normal than the same data does now. Stored verdicts and dissent-log entries are NOT retroactively recomputed.
